title: OpenAI's new voice mode makes it to the ChatGPT desktop app | TechCrunch
summary: OpenAI on Thursday said it has updated its ChatGPT desktop app to add support for ChatGPT Voice, allowing users to talk to the app to control AI agents and perform tasks on their computer.
